company.description: Madfu to promote the payments sector in the kingdom of Saudi Arabia in several different fields in order to relieve the financial pressures on individuals and enable them to keep up with the requirements of modern life more easily and achieve mutual benefits with shopkeepers and service providers without any hidden interest or fee.

productsAndServices.description: MADFU collaborates with various stores in the entertainment, restaurant, and beauty sectors, offering a platform for these stores to attract a larger customer base by providing installment payment options.

productsAndServices.description: All services provided by MADFU are reviewed by a specialized Sharia committee to ensure compliance with Islamic Sharia controls.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Seed round raised $25,388,131, or 84.86% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $8,448,031 to $99,973,633, a 11.83x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 70 (-12 over 90 days) and market heat at 49 (-8).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
